The seating lookahead is voided by the deltas, and the deltas were always honest.

# WHAT IT DOES CHANGE: the causal arms' LEVELS.  CAUSAL_TAU_ORACLE was published as an UPPER BOUND on any threshold-shaped causal rule; on the honest denominator that bound is far lower than printed, because it was earned in 128-154 sessions of 385-390.
